recordText: From the 1590s, meaning noble-minded and straightforward. Latin *ingenuus* first meant native or freeborn, literally "born in." The sense "artless, innocent" arrives in the 1670s. In the 1600s it was confused with *ingenious* so often that even Shakespeare mixed them up.
gossipText: The innocent one. Has never once noticed she's in the wrong seat.
